# Low Poly Airfield — Free Sample

**Creator:** EH98  
**Fab listing:** https://www.fab.com/listings/43f8170e-349b-46d6-937b-66c7f511d3c1  
**Acquired:** 2026-11-18  
**Fab license:** Standard Fab EULA (accepted by project owner for this asset).  
**Listing/README terms:** free for personal and commercial projects; modifications permitted; do not resell or redistribute the source files as an asset pack. README says no attribution is required.

## Included FBX files

- `fbx/aircraft/plane_prop.fbx` — light high-wing aircraft, listed as 8.2 m / 842 triangles.
- `fbx/ground/cone.fbx` — marker cone.
- `fbx/ground/windsock.fbx` — windsock.

The models use flat shading and solid colours, with no textures or UV maps. They are authored Z-up in metres. The aircraft is a single mesh; its propeller and landing gear are not separately rigged.

This is a candidate for a scale and style review, not yet the approved final aircraft or finished Air Race pylon.
